name: Kilo Code
title: kilocode.ai
shortDescription: Kilo Code is an open source VS Code extension that enhances AI-driven development. It integrates features from Cline, Roo, and other tools to streamline coding tasks. Users can manage complex projects by breaking them into subtasks using Orchestrator Mode, design solutions with Architect Mode, and implement code with Code Mode. It's ideal for developers at innovative companies looking to optimize their workflow and focus on creative aspects of programming.
pros: Open source with active community contributions
cons: May require learning curve for new users

aiSuggestedAlternatives.reason: Popular IDE with extensive plugin support
